name: app-shater-typography-system-alexandria-font-specimen-and-scale
title: Shater typography system: 'Alexandria' font specimen with weight scale, size table and line-height table
whatItIs: A light page with an Arabic 'نظام الخط' (Type System) heading and rationale, a huge orange-gradient 'Alexandria' wordmark, a weight scale from Thin to Bold rendered as a waveform-like bar chart, a size table (Heading 20-24px, Subtitle 18-20px, Body 14-16px, Caption 12px) and a line-height table, with app screens below.
whatItMeans: Systematic and considered; visualising weights as a waveform makes an otherwise dry type scale memorable.
techniques: Render a font-weight scale as a bar-height waveform.
Pair size and line-height in matching small tables.
Show the typeface name itself in a gradient as the hero.

vocabulary.definition: The set of font sizes used across an interface.
How thick or thin a typeface's strokes are.
